verdict.rationale: The docs imply terminals can be ordered from the Customer Area, since the Management API orders them 'instead of the Customer Area'. A standalone terminal is offered as 'the quickest way to accept in-person payments', and Tap to Pay needs no extra hardware, all of which supports fast hardware-to-payments. Nothing in the evidence covers self-serve founder signup, approval/onboarding speed, or delivery timelines that would show payments running the same week. Missing for 10: documented self-serve signup flow, approval/KYC turnaround times, explicit dashboard hardware-ordering docs, shipping/activation timeline evidence, independent hands-on corroboration of a same-week go-live.
